summary: xapi-lib preinstall beacons installer IP to realwbx.com with hardcoded campaign token
details: xapi-lib declares a preinstall script (`node index.js`) that executes top-level code on every `npm install`. The top-level invocation calls `getPublicIPLocation('8.8.8.8')`, which issues an HTTPS GET to `realwbx.com/ip.php` with a hardcoded `Authorization: fa79878bc2cfb48bd5127ae26fb661b1` header, leaking the installer's public IP, install timing, and a campaign-correlation token to a third-party host unrelated to the package's publisher. The package otherwise ships only a one-line stub README, a generic description, and a thin wrapper around that single function, consistent with a reconnaissance/enumeration lure that identifies installers before follow-on payloads.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
